issues.where: the sky and the plume at upper right
issues.what: the plume is one dense, hard-edged grey column standing apart from the scene, and the sky above the cliffs is a clean blue; in -a the fume is a soft, wide drift lit orange from below that hazes the whole right side and the far rim
issues.fix: break the column into a broad, low, translucent drift, warm its underside with lava light, and let it veil the far rim and sky

issues.where: the lava channel across the foreground and middle
issues.what: the lava is a flat, even, pale-yellow pour with smooth sheet edges sitting in a cut trench; in -a it is a narrow, crusted channel with swirled skin, dark crust plates over it and glow only in the cracks and the hottest core
issues.fix: narrow the channel, put dark, swirled crust over most of it, and keep the bright yellow to a thin core and the cracks, falling to deep orange and red at the edges

issues.where: the dead animal in the foreground
issues.what: the body is a bulging, fabric-like mound with pale scale patches and a smooth CG skin; in -a it is a charred, bark-textured carcass half-sunk into ropy lava, dark and cracked with flaking ash-grey bark
issues.fix: char and darken the body, give it cracked bark-like skin that flakes, and sink it into the lava so the flow wraps it

issues.where: the crust on the right half of the floor
issues.what: the crust is light grey with a busy, repeating swirl pattern and hard straight cracks, like a tiled texture; in -a it is dark, ropy pāhoehoe with broad folds and soft depth-of-field falloff
issues.fix: darken the crust to near black-brown, replace the repeat pattern with large ropy folds, and soften it with distance

issues.where: the lava floor from mid-ground to the bottom edge
issues.what: the floor is a uniform grey with a small repeating swirl stamp and little depth softness; in -a it is dark, ropy, uneven crust that drops out of focus toward the camera and the distance
issues.fix: darken and vary the crust, use larger ropy flow forms, and add shallow depth-of-field like -a

issues.where: the far cliff wall and sky
issues.what: the wall is sharp, high-contrast, evenly lit grey stone, the sky clean blue, and the haze thin; in -a the wall is dim and soft behind thick smoke, the sky grey, and the right side glows orange through fume
issues.fix: lower contrast on the wall, add dense warm-lit haze across the back, and grey down the sky

issues.where: the ember glow under the carcass
issues.what: the glow is a few thin, saturated orange zigzag lines that light nothing around them; in -a the ember is a soft, warm spot that tints the fume and crust near it
issues.fix: soften the glow, let it spill onto the nearby crust and the wisp of smoke

issues.what: the rim walls are taller, sharper and more evenly lit, with crisp ledges and less atmospheric falloff; in -a they are dim, low-contrast and softened by haze, with the mesa glowing orange at its right base
issues.fix: lower the wall contrast, push haze into the rim, and warm the mesa's right side from the lava field

issues.where: the foreground rocks and fumaroles at left
issues.what: the rocks are scattered rounded boulders with a soft CG look and the steam is two small, clumped puffs; in -a the slope is jagged, broken black lava with a wide, soft steam drift rising across it
issues.fix: replace the boulders with angular broken lava, and widen the steam into a soft, translucent drift

issues.where: the lava floor in the middle and right
issues.what: the floor is pale grey with a regular polygon crack pattern like dried mud, and the glowing cracks are thin, even lines; in -a it is dark, ropy crust with irregular glowing seams
issues.fix: darken the floor, drop the mud-crack tiling, and make the glowing seams irregular and varied in width

issues.what: the left rocks are red-brown and sharp with no yellow sulphur, and the steam is a thin wash; in -a they are black lava with yellow sulphur crust and a soft white plume rising
issues.fix: darken the rocks, add the sulphur crust, and thicken the steam into a soft rising plume

issues.what: the back wall is sharper and brighter and the sky bluer, with a dark plume; in -a the back is lost in warm haze and the sky is grey
issues.fix: soften and dim the back wall, add warm haze, and grey the sky

issues.what: the animals are sharp against the haze and the near one stands on thin legs with a straight back; in -a they are slightly hazed and the near one has the drooping, dragging trunk lit orange at its tip
issues.fix: haze them to match their distance and give the near one the lit, dragging trunk

issues.what: the fire is a puff of smoke with a spray of sparks; in -a it is a low line of flame along a crack
issues.fix: lay the fire along the crack as a low flame line
